title: Jiwa Nyang Meuharga Nyang Meutanyakan Otoritas .
intro: Lam kitab-kitab Al-Quran, na sidroe tokoh nyang keukayaan ngon ilme jih jeuet keu legenda. Jiwa nyoe teuka nibak bumoe deungon hiasan dan hareuta nyang jipeusilau ureueng-ureueng nyang kalon, bahpih meunan até awaknyan meutamah sombong ngon sombong. Gabong deungon kamoë bak kamoë buka misteri salah saboh kisah Al-Quran njang paléng meu-ingat, dipat keubeusaran materi meurumpok deungon ujong njang meu-rendah di mijub tanoh njang peulahé raseuki awaknjan.
clues: Lon teuka nibak bumoe nyang meuhias ngon hiasan nyang jicok pandangan mandum ureueng.
Lon na keukayaan nyang luah dan ilme nyang dalam nyang peubida lon ngon ureueng laen.
Watèë teuka rasul geuhôi ureuëng keu Allah, ulôn peukara keukuasaan awaknjan deungon sombong.
Ureuëng-ureuëng di seukitar ulôn meubisiek-bisik bahwa nikmat Allah kon sumber hareuta ulôn.
Ureuëng ulôn hireuen keu keubeusaran ulôn dan meuharab keu nasib nyang saban lagée ulôn.
Struktur-struktur lôn nyang meugah nyan ka jiteulon banmandum u bumoe sibagoe huköman ilahi.

trial.answer: Deungon sombong geupeutanya keukuasaan sidroe nabi .

location.label: Unsur Kunci
options: Semak nyang tutong di Gunong Sinai .

outcome.label: Hasee
options: Dipeutron u laot di teungoh-teungoh geulanteu ngon gelombang .
Geubeudoh hudép u syeuruga sibagoe tanda .
Dipeuhah le bumoe deungon penyesalan abadi .

arabic: وَقَـٰرُونَ وَفِرْعَوْنَ وَهَـٰمَـٰنَ ۖ وَلَقَدْ جَآءَهُم مُّوسَىٰ بِٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ فَٱسْتَكْبَرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا كَانُوا۟ سَـٰبِقِينَ
verse: And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrunners [of Our punishment]. (29:39)
